anti_analysis: silent_exit_on_debugger (WinMain returns 0 with no payload decryption if checks trip)
stack_string_obfuscation (svchost.exe target path built from immediates)
runtime_resolution_of_ntdll_natives (keeps Nt* APIs out of the import table)

decoded_strings.decryption_recipe: plaintext = RC4( XOR(ciphertext, repeating deadbeef1337cafebabe) ) with RC4 key 'Hollowing_PE!!!!'; both layers are involutions applied exactly as in WinMain

encryption_details.algorithm: Two-layer symmetric encryption of the embedded payload: (1) repeating-key XOR with a 10-byte key, then (2) RC4 (KSA+PRGA, 256-byte state) with a 16-byte key. Decryption in WinMain: xor_decrypt(buf,64,g_xor_key,10) followed by rc4_init/rc4_crypt with g_rc4_key.
encryption_details.key: XOR key: de ad be ef 13 37 ca fe ba be ('deadbeef1337cafebabe', 10 bytes used of a 16-byte zero-padded array). RC4 key: 'Hollowing_PE!!!!' (16 bytes).
encryption_details.key_storage: Both keys are hardcoded global constants in .rdata: g_xor_key @ VA 0x140005000, g_rc4_key @ VA 0x140005010 (immediately followed by plaintext ntdll API-name strings). The 64-byte ciphertext is g_encrypted_pe_stub in .data @ VA 0x140004000.

file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13, unstripped with DWARF debug symbols

injection_details.entry_point_redirect: GetThreadContext/SetThreadContext with ContextFlags=0x10000B; sets RCX (CONTEXT+0x80) = payload base, so RtlUserThreadStart transfers control to the injected stub on ResumeThread
injection_details.method: Process hollowing: CreateProcessA with CREATE_SUSPENDED (4) -> NtQueryInformationProcess(ProcessBasicInformation) to get PEB -> NtReadVirtualMemory(PEB+0x10) to read victim image base -> NtUnmapViewOfSection(image base) -> VirtualAllocEx (MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE 0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE 0x40; fallback base=NULL) -> WriteProcessMemory -> SetThreadContext -> ResumeThread; Sleep(2000) after injection
injection_details.payload: 64-byte stub stored encrypted as g_encrypted_pe_stub in .data (0x140004000); decrypted at runtime (XOR key deadbeef1337cafebabe, then RC4 'Hollowing_PE!!!!') and written raw at the allocated base (not a section-mapped PE)
injection_details.payload_write: Single WriteProcessMemory of 0x40 (64) bytes to the remotely allocated RWX region
injection_details.target_discovery: Hardcoded path assembled on the stack via mov imm64 immediates (stack string): 'C:\Windows\System32\svchost.exe'
